rubric_notes: Complete and accurate hierarchy (class a 46456, fold a.22 47112, superfamily a.22.1 47113, four families with SUNIDs) in SCOPe 2.08; superfamily supports probable domain-level common ancestry but not the closer family relationship; explicit refusal to transfer nucleosome assembly, chromatin packaging, DNA-binding mode, transcriptional role, partners, oligomeric state, or enzymatic activity; H1/H5, H-NS, and histone-modifying enzymes correctly handled with note that different superfamilies do not prove nonhomology; bacterial duplication annotation and 'not a true family' comment verified. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-22.

All SCCS, SUNIDs, and boundary correct and bundle-supported. Superfamily a.204.1 as deepest shared node supporting remote homology; correctly notes SCOPe does not imply homology above superfamily (supported by fold homology response); family divergence stated; rejects transfer of HisE reaction, MazG specificity, substrates, catalytic residues, pathway roles, oligomeric states, and template interchangeability; correctly cautions that Li/UNL comment is not functional evidence; lists required external evidence. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily, fold 53066 and duplication annotation, all supported (homology endpoints cited). Infers remote homology of catalytic-domain cores; explicitly rejects transfer of actin/HSP70 activities, glucose/glycerol specificity, reaction chemistry, active-site residues, regulation, oligomeric state, templates; lists required external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; 2026-10-22. Correct family/superfamily/fold/class with SUNIDs matching bundle; fold core and bimetal-ion centre annotations supported by its bundle. Interprets as probable common ancestry with family-level divergence, explicitly not same-fold analogy; keeps the three chemistries family-specific and notes the RNR-like label does not guarantee R2 chemistry; refuses transfer of substrate, metal, residues, mechanism, oligomeric state; lists required sequence, active-site, metal-bound structural, biochemical, phylogenetic evidence. Complete.

Complete and well-supported: all three families, superfamily b.6.1 and fold b.6 with correct SUNIDs; superfamily-level common ancestry vs fold; PAD4 N-terminal domain-only scope; family comments 'lacking the metal-binding site' cited against the general superfamily copper comment. Rejects copper/electron-transfer transfer and lists alignment of metal-ligating residues, ligand-bound structural/spectroscopic evidence, binding and redox assays, domain context. No errors.

All identifiers (families, SUNIDs, superfamily, fold, class) correct and bundle-supported. Clearly states superfamily supports common ancestry beyond fold-level resemblance, applies conclusion to domains not whole proteins, and explicitly rejects transfer of conjugation/proteasomal signaling, p97/VCP binding, and Ras-GTPase binding; lists required evidence and notes hierarchy does not pick a best representative. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All three families, SUNIDs, superfamily 52172, fold c.23 and class c correct and bundle-supported. Concludes probable common ancestry at superfamily level without family-level or whole-protein functional equivalence; explicitly rejects receiver phosphorylation/two-component signaling, ornithine binding/decarboxylase chemistry, and KaiA circadian/Kai-interaction transfer in both directions. Correctly cites the SCOPe comment that the KaiA family lacks canonical receiver features. Lists appropriate external evidence. No material errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Correct protein/family/superfamily/fold lineage with SUNIDs; states fold-level architecture is shared but homology not implied above superfamily, b.84.5 asserts ancestry only within itself with b.84.5.1 as the closer family-level relationship, and separation is not a positive nonhomology claim. Rejects function/template transfer and lists external evidence needed. PubMed and identifiers verified in bundle.

Correct f.21.1/f.21.2/f.21.3 under f.21 with matching SUNIDs in 2.08; cites fold homology record, f.21.3 'possible link' comment, and f.21.2 chain-organization comment accurately. Explicitly states separation does not prove nonhomology/convergence and enumerates structural alignment, core sequence and ligand-motif correspondence, domain/complex context, phylogeny, and biochemical evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families with SUNIDs in superfamily c.2.1 (51735) and fold c.2 (51734); superfamily interpreted as probable common ancestry, families as divergence with within-family relationships closer. Rejects transfer of ADH chemistry, CoA/synthetase chemistry, NAD/NADP preference, channel gating; domain vs whole-protein distinction; Pfam mapping as provenance; AEROSPACI/SPACI correctly framed as quality, not evolution. External evidence requirements stated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Complete identifier set (domain, protein, family, superfamily, fold, class SUNIDs), quotes 'not a true family' (in bundle), explains ordinary level semantics and why the annotation blocks family-level homology inference for this pair, notes nonhomology is not proven either, rejects amyloidogenicity and ligand-based transfer, and names required external evidence. Complete and calibrated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: 1.69 d1t1ja_ (106249) in fold c.137 (110459)/c.137.1/c.137.1.1 vs d1f8ya_ (31395) c.23/c.23.14/c.23.14.1; 2.08 d1t1ja1 A:1-118 moved to c.23.14.2 under superfamily 52309 while 1f8y stays c.23.14.1. Correctly states the deepest shared level moved from class to superfamily (probable common ancestry, not family equivalence), cites the superfamily active-site annotation (in bundle) without over-transferring function, and notes the API does not expose the curatorial rationale. Periodic vs stable release handled correctly. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: d1a14h1 SUNID 20061, b.1.1.1, H:9-111 Ig VH; d1a14h2 SUNID 343393, l.1.1.1, H:1-8 under Artifacts/Tags/synthetic N-terminal tags; artifact warning cited and supported. Rejects homology, function transfer, and template use from tag similarity, recommends masking, and appropriately notes the tag's exact chemical identity cannot be determined from SCOPe records. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1); 2026-10-22.

All required content is present and correct: 1.75 unsplit d1acca_ (43828, f.11.1.1) persisting through 2.03, replaced in 2.04, retained in 2.08, with correct SUNIDs, spans, and named folds, superfamilies, and families, plus residues 1-13 left unclassified. Draws the reusable-module inference, declines to infer independent origin or nonhomology from differing classes, rejects equating a one-segment hit with legacy d1acca_ or with protective-antigen function, and names the external evidence needed for stronger claims. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All SIDs, SUNIDs, boundaries, and SCCS correct and evidence-backed; d3jb9a5 47-697 identified as new fold d.394. Mosaic conclusion, four reused lineages vs novel N-terminal domain, superfamily placement supports ancestry but not activity, lists external evidence needed for stronger claims. No must_avoid violations.

Correct shared family a.298.1.1 (SUNID 267609) with per-domain SUNIDs and full lineage; explains repeat-copy-number variation using the 're' caveat, the 'single repeat' annotation, and the canonical repeat representative d4cj9a_ A:259-292. Lengths 51/373/752 are correctly qualified as observed ATOM-sequence lengths rather than full encoded protein lengths. Adds the apt point that canonical-representative status does not imply best template or highest quality, and notes ASTRAL quality was not queried. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; timestamp 2026-10-22.

Metadata correct and supported by its /releases/current evidence. Cites 2.08-stable as the concrete stable release and states the periodic label does not replace the stable release. Does not mention preserving the dated label when periodic-only entries are used, and does not explain that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting older domains; instead hedges that the metadata cannot show what changed. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Accurate a.47.2.1 placement across all five domains with correct hierarchy; cites the fragment comment and ms caveat for every 1br0/1ez3 domain and the four-long-helix fold annotation; correctly reinterprets the spectrin-like appearance as an incomplete three-helix portion of the four-helix domain and rejects spectrin homology/convergence/separate-fold readings. Notes d1dn1b_ lacks the fragment caveat, is an automated match to d3c98b_, and that 1dn1 is obsolete in favor of 3c98 without weakening the family assignment. Fragments limited to local template use; function transfer appropriately gated. No material errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All identifiers correct and bundle-supported: c.2 51734/c.2.1 51735, c.3 51904/c.3.1 51905, c.1 51350/c.1.7 51430, class c 51349. Clean statement that superfamily is SCOPe's probable-common-ancestry assertion (divergence), family closer, and across superfamilies/folds SCOPe makes no ancestry claim; convergence consistent but unproven, remote divergence possible. Chemical/geometric constraint argument for local convergence; refuses transfer of reaction, substrate, NAD/NADP preference, mechanism, boundaries, template status. Requires core sequence/profile correspondence, global alignment with topology, conserved residues in equivalent context, architecture, phylogeny, literature; notes positive convergence claims also need evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Complete before/after comparison: 2.04 b.23.2.1 in CUB-like fold versus b.18.1.3, deepest shared node only class b; 2.08 ColG moved to b.18.1.36 (SUNID 267607) under superfamily b.18.1 (SUNID 49785) while Cry3A stays b.18.1.3 (SUNID 49796), so superfamily shared but families distinct. Structural bridge quantified correctly from the bundle (1nqdA to representative 1nqjA at 99.16% identity; 1nqjA to d1w99a3 p=0.00395, RMSD 2.52, 2.5% identity; 1dlcA to d1w99a3 RMSD 1.43, p=0.0002) with the representative caveat stated. Correctly notes Cry4Ba and Cry3A share family b.18.1.3. Functional similarity framed as plausible but not decisive; rejects transfer of collagen binding, calcium dependence, catalysis, receptor specificity, insecticidal activity, pore formation, and interchangeable templating; lists the external evidence needed.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Close homology justified via family/superfamily/protein/species sharing; hf does not erase it and is correctly paraphrased (domain-scoped, non-inherited, different fold despite similar sequence and SS count); rejects assumed interchangeable topology, residue correspondence, geometry, binding-site configuration and template suitability; mutant/NHE noted; template use requires alignments, boundary checks, quality comparison and ligand/conformational evidence; ML guidance preserves or stratifies hf, forbids relabeling as nonhomology, and requires sequence-identity evidence (ASTRAL subset) to establish redundancy. SUNIDs, boundaries (A:0-59, chain D) and release 2.08 all supported by the bundle. Complete.

Meets all criteria: shared family supports close homology not erased by fr; alignment masks unobserved positions and avoids raw global similarity; prefer/add a complete family member as representative with d1o5dt2 stratified as fragment/complex example; truncation not counted as diversity. Correctly identifies SPACI/AEROSPACI as technical-quality measures, not completeness or homology scores, and correctly notes resolution/R-factor fields are null for one or both entries. Identifiers, boundaries, protein nodes, cr9 comment all match evidence. Function transfer rejected. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

All four must_include points covered: new superfamily given fold match without ancestry evidence; new family as probable common origin with a closer subgroup; new fold only if topology is not represented by the known fold; placement framed as revisable with integrated sequence, structural, architectural, phylogenetic, and experimental evidence. Explicitly states separation does not prove nonhomology and rejects fold-only function/template transfer. Attributes the SCOPe 2.08 stable-release statement to public service metadata, but the evidence bundle is empty, so that API-derived claim is unsupported (noncentral, fact itself not fabricated). Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Fully supported hierarchy with names and SUNIDs: 'Protein kinases, catalytic subunit' 88854/d.144.1.7, 'APH phosphotransferases' 64411/d.144.1.6, 'PI3K, catalytic domain' 56171/d.144.1.4, superfamily 56112/d.144.1, fold 56111/d.144, class 53931/d (all in bundle). States that shared superfamily supports probable common ancestry of catalytic domains, not merely fold, and that SCOPe does not establish identical catalytic residues or chemistry. Explicit named refusals: protein-substrate recognition, aminoglycoside specificity, PI3K lipid specificity/membrane recruitment/regulation, inhibitor sensitivity, kinetics, activation mechanisms, docking motifs, regulatory phosphorylation, partner dependence, oligomeric state. Evidence list covers sequence/structural alignments of catalytic and specificity residues, substrate/cofactor-bound structures, kinetics, binding, mutagenesis, full-length domain context, regulatory interfaces, PTMs, cellular assays, phylogeny. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.
